android.releaseNotes:
• WhatsApp/Instagram-Grade VoIP Calling & Handset Proximity Sensor: Added native ear-detection screen blanking during earpiece calls to prevent accidental touch inputs, default earpiece audio routing with speaker/bluetooth toggle.
• In-Call Floating PIP Overlay: Active calls can now be minimized into a floating, draggable mini-overlay with live video/pulsating avatar and quick mute/hangup controls while navigating the app.

windows.releaseNotes:
• In-Call Floating Call Overlay: Active calls can be minimized into a floating mini-overlay with live video and quick controls while browsing.
• Robust Call Routing: Seamless audio route handling, earpiece default, and resilience across screen share and video toggling.
